jobs.description:
Account Management & Business Development

• Develops and executes account plans to achieve sales, margin and customer development objectives.

Commercial & Performance Management

• Works with Finance on receivables, credit exposure and customer financial risk.

• Knowledge of the Microsoft Office environment

Our client is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. The company serves a diverse global marketplace with innovative polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials. With a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide, our client has established itself as a global industry leader, recognized for its high-quality products, advanced manufacturing technologies, and commitment to employee development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for:

• Operating and setting up production machines according to production guidelines and specifications.
• Cutting and processing foam blocks based on customer and production requirements.
• Performing quality checks on finished products, including dimensions, shape, color, and compliance with specifications.
• Using measuring tools during the production process.
• Registering production data and labeling products in the Carpy system.
• Transporting materials and products between workstations using an electric pallet truck.
• Ensuring the proper operation of machinery and carrying out basic maintenance tasks when required.

Requirements

• Previous experience in a production or manufacturing environment.
• Technical aptitude and an interest in operating machinery.
• Ability to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to quality.
• Good teamwork and communication skills.
• Working knowledge of English or Dutch sufficient for workplace communication.

• Guide clients during the complete process of a project (follow up from A till Z),  
• Assist clients with tax audits and tax claims,  
• Handle compliance services for individuals (also expatriates):salary splits, expat calculations,…  
• Prepare resident and non-resident income tax returns  
• Assist international companies with HR matters: employment, labour contracts, optimisation of salary packages etc.,   
• Provide clients with clear (written) advice by conducting research and making the necessary calculations,  
• Be in direct contact with clients, colleagues abroad and other partner organizations. 
  
• Master s degree in (Applied) Economic Sciences or Commercial Sciences or a degree in Law, or a degree in business management  
• A tax degree is a plus,  
• Specialization in Personal income tax for expats or salary split,  
• Fluent in Dutch/Flemish, English and French,  
• Ability to work autonomously and work as a team player with excellent project management skills,  
• Flexible, accurate and eager to learn,  
• Good communication and organizational skills,  
• Proactive and hands on mentality,  
• Adherence to the highest degree of professional standards and strict client confidentiality.

Our client is a leading Belgian dealer and service partner for commercial vehicles, vans, and trucks, with multiple locations across East and West Flanders, including Brugge, Ardooie, Bavikhove, Deinze, and Aalter. The company is known for its expertise, customer-focused approach, and commitment to quality service.

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for a Diagnostic Technician to join a growing and stable automotive company specializing in vans and trucks. Brand experience is not important. What matters most is your diagnostic knowledge and ability to identify and solve technical issues efficiently.

As a Diagnostic Technician, you will be responsible for:

• Performing advanced mechanical, electrical and electronic diagnostics on vans and trucks using diagnostic equipment and vehicle software.
• Identifying faults and determining the most efficient repair strategy.
• Repairing and adjusting mechanical, electrical and electronic systems based on diagnostic findings.
• Communicating diagnostic results and completed repairs clearly to workshop management and service advisors.

Candidate Profile

• Passion for automotive technology and troubleshooting.
• Technical education in automotive engineering, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent practical experience.
• Good knowledge of vehicle diagnostics and diagnostic software.
• Experience with diagnostic equipment is required.
• Experience with a specific vehicle brand is not necessary.
• Experience with vans, commercial vehicles or trucks is an advantage.
• HEV1 certificate is a plus.
• Analytical, accurate and problem-solving mindset.
• Candidates must be able to communicate in Dutch or English.

Since its founding in 1891, a culture of continuous innovation has made our client one of the world's leading manufacturers of heavy trucks and buses.

It's unique modular product system, developed over several decades, is one of our key success factors. It is an integral part of our flexible approach and lies at the heart of our business model.

Jobomschrijving

You will independently perform maintenance and repair work on our fleet of vehicles, including trucks and buses.You'll work with a premium brand, and we’ll turn you into a true specialist in your field!

You’ll join a close team of experienced technicians, all working together toward one goal: providing fast and efficient service to our customers.

We are looking for a passionate mechanic with:

• Technical training (A2 or bachelor's degree) in automotive mechanics, electricity, or truck technology.
•  
• Knowledge of or experience with heavy vehicles such as trucks, agricultural vehicles, or forklifts.
•  
• The ability to work independently.
•  
• The motivation to continuously learn through our training programs.
•  
• You speak good Dutch or good English.

A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?
  
Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!
  
As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.
  
But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail. 
  
You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.
  
The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.
  
No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!
  
Your responsibilities cover two main areas.
  
Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes
    
• You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.  
• You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.  
• You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.  
• You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.  
• You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.  
• You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.  
• You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.  
• When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.   
Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!
  
Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.
  
This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.
    
• You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.  
• You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.  
• You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.  
• You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.  
• You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.  
• You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.  
• You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.   
And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.
  
No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.
  
We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.
  
Does this sound like you?
    
• Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.  
• You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.  
• You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.  
• Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.  
• You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.  
• You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.  
• You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!   
What else do you bring?
    
• A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.  
• Previous experience in a similar position is a definite advantage, but the right attitude, maturity and potential to grow into the role are just as valuable.  
• Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, ideally together with good written French.  
• A valid category B driving licence.   
And the right personal fit? That's just as important to us.
  
You feel at home in a dynamic, informal environment with a relatively young team. You're positive, engaged and bring a healthy dose of common sense.
  
Ultimately, we're looking for someone management can turn to and say: "Could you take care of this?" And know it's in good hands.

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job,it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing,we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, located in Drongen (9031), is looking for a reliable and motivated Production Worker to join their woodworking production department. This position is ideal for candidates seeking stable daytime employment in a production environment. Previous experience with wood or woodworking is not required, as all necessary training will be provided.

Responsibilities

• Removing wooden boards from the profiling machine
• Performing quality checks on wooden boards
• Feeding wooden boards into the wide-belt sanding machine
• Following production and safety procedures
• Contributing to a smooth and efficient production process

Candidate Profile

• Comfortable performing repetitive production work
• Physically fit and able to carry out heavy manual tasks
• Reliable, punctual, and committed to attendance
• Motivated to learn and follow quality standards
• Previous woodworking experience is not required
• You can communicate in Dutch, or English, or French
Knowledge of wood products is not necessary, and quality control tasks can be learned on the job.

The most important qualities for this role are reliability, punctuality, and consistency. Please note that the work is highly repetitive and physically demanding, making it most suitable for candidates who enjoy routine production tasks and can maintain focus throughout the day.

Robert Half is currently looking for a Senior Corporate Accountant (m/f/x) for a permanent position.

 

 

Our client is an international company located in Groot-Bijgaarden.

 

As a Senior Corporate Accountant, your responsibilities will include:

• Coordinating accounting activities and ensuring accurate financial reporting.
• Supervising month-end and year-end closing activities, reconciliations and general ledger processes.
• Monitoring budgets, costs and financial performance within the assigned scope.
• Managing tax compliance, audit support and statutory reporting requirements.
• Supporting business projects, process improvements and the integration of new entities.
• Coaching accounting team members and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
 

The required qualifications for this position of Senior Corporate Accountant are:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent through experience.
• You have at least 5 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting.
• You have experience preparing financial statements.
• Experience within an international or shared service environment is considered an asset.
• A first people management or coaching experience is a plus.
• Experience within the Services or Retail sector is required.
• You have knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP.
• Experience with ERP implementations, migrations or system improvement projects is a strong asset.
• You are fluent in English and French.
• You have advanced Excel skills and experience working with SAP. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Kuurne.Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit? 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Our client produces excellent and consistent mushroom substrate with respect for people and nature.Quality and flexibility are top priorities for our client.The company is located in a traffic-free area in Roeselare.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, we are looking for a motivated INDUSTRIAL CLEANER.

• Assisting with emptying the tunnels (partially mechanical/partially manual)
• Cleaning large tunnels using a high-pressure cleaner

• You actively contribute to the cleaning process

Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

Jobomschrijving

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:

• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!

• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.
• You have basic PC skills.
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.
• You speak good Dutch or English.
